```{=html}
</svg><text x="20" y="268" font-size="23" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="start" font-weight="700">where it extends</text><text x="20" y="300" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">· more, smaller departments = fine-grained experts (DeepSeekMoE): the activation ratio falls</text><text x="20" y="332" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">· a front desk every patient passes = the shared expert</text><text x="20" y="364" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">· transfers between hospitals = all-to-all communication across devices: the real bottleneck (W11)</text><text x="20" y="412" font-size="23" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="start" font-weight="700">where it fails</text><text x="20" y="444" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">· the desk learns favourites: a chosen department trains more, gets chosen more; the rest starve</text><text x="20" y="476" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">· "which department" is a discrete choice: no gradient through the selection, only the gate value</text><text x="20" y="508" font-size="23" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" font-weight="400">· departments are not specialities: Mixtral routes by syntax and position more than by topic (§5)</text></svg>
```
